docs.purpose: An operator's at-a-glance read on how the mobile and web apps are behaving. Five tiles show the crash rate over the last day, how many sign-in attempts succeed by method over the last week, how often a viewed lead gets saved, how often the paywall gets clicked, and how much cache-refresh chatter there was. Each tile links out to the deeper analytics tools, and a tile that cannot reach its data source says so with the reason instead of showing a wrong number.
